title: stemona tuberosa var. minor
intro: Stemona tuberosa var. minor, commonly known as Lesser Tonga Katira, is a variant of the Stemona tuberosa plant species, belonging to the Asparagaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Tonga Katira include modulating blood sugar levels, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
